svg.aria-label: HSBC Private Bank Family Lifetime Core functional architecture
svg.text: HSBC PRIVATE BANK · FAMILY LIFETIME CORE
One primary key, six layers, twelve capability domains. Family is the service view; Party / Entity / Trust / Estate are the legal subjects.
Authority is checked before any action; every decision is replayable and evidence-linked.
Self-built core. The Avaloq contract is not renewed.
Pipeline, case queue, pre-trade, next action
L2 · LIFECYCLE CORE — new build, the differentiator
Who can act, for what, until when,
event ledger · evidence · decisions · audit · AI copilot (read-only, cited)
family revenue · retention · wallet share · NPS
L1 · LEGAL ENTITY & RELATIONSHIP GRAPH — new build
Avaloq BP / REL fields are an input only — they do not define legal authority.
L0 · LEDGER & TRANSACTION — self-built, reference + rewrite
Avaloq: functional reference and migration source only. No renewal; no long-term dual core.
One primary key: Family × Party × Role × Authority × Event × Evidence.
Public cases are structural references only; account-level data in the prototypes is illustrative. Internal design input — not legal, tax or investment advice.
